annotation.title_clean: General principles on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.title_en: General principles on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela on behalf of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM) and Other States Parties to the CCW
annotation.venue: CCW Group of Governmental Experts (UN Geneva), CCW/GGE.1/2018/WP.1
annotation.summary_en: Working paper submitted by Venezuela for the Non-Aligned Movement to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts, setting out NAM's position on lethal autonomous weapons systems: discussion should cover international law, state responsibility, ethics and arms-race risks, and aim at a legally binding instrument, with interim moratoria.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a legally binding international instrument prohibiting and regulating LAWS
Voluntary measures, codes of conduct and weapons reviews cannot substitute for a binding instrument
All weapons must remain under direct human control and supervision and comply with IHL and IHRL
Calls on all States to declare moratoria on development and use of LAWS pending a treaty
Discussion should address state responsibility, ethical concerns, definitions, arms race and technology gap
